detail.derivation: READ_CALLS=3 => MAX_TURNS = 3+2 = 5 => worst case 6 per sample => 45x6 + 15x2 = 300 => 1.3x => 390

criteria_evaluation.evaluated_at: the amended zero-API gate, before any paid request

where.zero_render_failures_zero_truncations_ze: the frozen gate's trigger-gate, mechanism and literal-invariant assertions, all of which are zero-API; the batch's own rows are judged by the independent audit
where.every_arms_strict_track_at_or_above_the_: the frozen gate's first-prompt assertion, which is what makes the strict track arm-neutral; the per-task track is judged by the independent audit
where.every_arms_semantic_correctness_at_or_ab: the frozen gate's retry-wording assertion, which is what keeps the answer reachable in every arm; the endpoint is judged by the independent audit
where.retry_recovery_rate_at_least_90_percent: the gate can only establish that the repair path is installed and two-sided; the rate itself is a property of the batch and is measured by the independent audit

criteria_evaluation.measured_by_the_recalibration: five of five first-attempt rejections repaired to an accepted answer, which is the amendment's own measurement and is disclosed as such rather than re-derived here
criteria_evaluation.residual_risk_carried_into_this_batch: at 44 percent first-attempt acceptance, roughly half of the samples are expected to spend the single billed retry; retries are charged to their arm, they add calls to a trajectory, and in earlier batches one asymmetric retry moved a pooled mean by 7 to 21 percentage points

detail.the_recorded_batch_id_is_the_one_the_del: the gate was written under the delegate's requested id; the id the work actually landed under is the frozen one, which is checked separately below rather than folded into this check

detail.why_the_id_strings_differ: the frozen runner's own ``forced_args`` replaces ``--experiment-id`` with the id the confirmation freeze pre-registers, so the paid path cannot run under any other id; the request was recorded, refused by the frozen resolver, and the batch ran under the frozen id as the freeze requires
detail.why_this_is_not_a_weakened_check: the pins the decision rests on - the amendment, the delegate that carries it, the frozen runner and the freeze - are all compared with what the gate recorded and with the files on disk, so an edited amendment or delegate fails here even though both id strings match

detail.freeze_prior_failure: task django-15572 (autoreload_template_changed) failed rendering on all fifteen of its samples across all three arms: the first answer exceeded the 160-character bound and the single billed retry still exceeded it, so the answers closed empty
detail.exhaustion: these three tasks were run once before, under the v23 configuration, and the batch stopped at 39 of 45 samples because django-15572 failed rendering on all fifteen of its samples; this batch is the second run of the same task set, under the v24 configuration, and the task set is exhausted by it

primary_criterion.name: as-paired complete provider tokens
primary_criterion.definition: for every (task, repeat) pair: (baseline total provider tokens - plugin total provider tokens) / baseline total provider tokens, where a sample's total is its complete provider input tokens plus its complete provider output tokens, with retries and summary requests charged to the arm they belong to

bootstrap.note: reported for explanation; the frozen verdict is the per-task strict track, the majority of positive pairs and the batch mean

zero_render_failures_zero_truncations_ze.gate_clause: zero render failures, zero truncations, zero dropped fields

every_arms_strict_track_at_or_above_the_.gate_clause: every arm's strict track at or above the baseline

every_arms_semantic_correctness_at_or_ab.gate_clause: every arm's semantic correctness at or above the baseline

retry_recovery_rate_at_least_90_percent.gate_clause: retry recovery rate at least 90 percent, measured at five of five

first_attempt_acceptance.replaced_line: the recalibration's 70 percent first-attempt acceptance line is NOT met and is not claimed: the amendment replaced it as the gate

co_reported.symmetric_matched_prefix_rule: per pair, k = min(baseline model calls, plugin model calls) and the same first k calls of each arm are compared; the truncation is symmetric by construction and each pair records the two call counts it was taken over

autoreload_template_changed.consequence: the defect view is the last read, so the mechanism keeps that tool group verbatim on every later model input; its literals are never at risk and no saving may be attributed to it
autoreload_template_changed.reported_as: an explanatory fact of the task shape, disclosed before the batch and not claimed as a merit of the mechanism
